pretreatment: Piranha treatment followed by a 2 min dilute HF (2 % HF) etch
evidence: Piranha treatment (volume ratio of concentrated H2SO4/H2O2 7:3) followed by a 2 min dilute HF (2 % HF) etch was performed on the patterned sample. This treatment removed the native oxide from the "bare" silicon, replacing it with hydride termination (Si–H), leaving hydroxylated SiO in the SiO2-patterned regions.
